newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Bancorp Q1 net shr $0.24.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Bancorp Q1 net shr $0.24.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
The company said total assets at March 31, 1997 were $333.8 million compared to $327.0 million reported one year earlier.
Total loans, net of the allowance for loan losses, increased $29.1 million to $291.6 million at March 31, 1997 from $262.5 million reported one year earlier, an increase of 11%.

The company said the quality of the loan portfolio was further enhanced as evidenced by the decline in non-performing loans as a percentage of total loans from 0.49 percent at March 31, 1996 to 0.47 percent at March 31, 1997.
